data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 560.438m. During 2023 there was favourable prior-year development with a gross release of GBP 36.44m (approximately 6.5% of opening gross claims), driven by favourable claims development across prior underwriting years and a generally benign claims environment. The managing agent notes the broader impact of named events in prior years such as Hurricane Ian and US winter storm Elliott (2022) and losses arising from the Ukraine conflict, although the quantified prior-year movement is a net release overall.
raw_causal_phrases: benefitted from a low incidence of natural catastrophes, although has been impacted by losses arising from the Ukraine conflict.
a series of natural catastrophes - the largest being Hurricane Ian and US winter storm Elliott.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and prior-year movement taken from the Technical Provisions note (Movements in technical provisions) - 'At 1 January' gross claims and 'Movement arising from prior years' gross column. No LOB-level prior-year reserve movements are provided. No gross claims development triangle was present in the extracted pages, so triangle-based cross-check could not be performed.
